drilldown_contract.source: StandardUserAction keeps non-date selected conditions and passes them to generateAggregateSearchDataModel. V5 resolves search prop through item-meaning override or prod_groupN refer_type; V56 uses qualified prop ID. For $$multi_code target and nonempty clicked value.code, writes result[search_prop_id]=[value].
drilldown_contract.all_selected_groups: Different group1/2/3 targets can be placed in the returned filter object together. Backend Boolean semantics and original general grouping are not established by this helper.
drilldown_contract.blank_boundary: If clicked value.code is empty, this helper does not add the $$multi_code filter; this does not establish whole blank-group navigation behavior because other conditions/defaults/receivers may apply.
drilldown_contract.identifier_boundary: Drilldown code check and legacy conversion sid extraction are distinct consumers. No static proof that code==sid, or that display name is an identifier.

legacy_conversion.source: ConvertSearchConditionV3Program creates a legacy search-condition DTO. PROD_CLASS_CD1/2/3 come from prod$prod$prod_group1/2/3 through getItemCode, which extracts each .sid and joins with∬. PROD_LEVEL_GROUP is a separate field.
legacy_conversion.boundary: Legacy compatibility/filter DTO only. No original legacy API invoked; this is not the current ordinary aggregate GROUPBY implementation or a hierarchy expansion rule.

ordinary_group_condition_consumers.selection: Current compatible generic selector targets summary/summary_code template properties. Return includes dynamic prop_id,label,refer_type,data_type,prop_name,item_meaning_id.
ordinary_group_condition_consumers.layout: processFreeAggregateCondition consumes that prop_id and dynamic grid property definition/attributes, carries label=condition.label||prop_name into aggregate config. Actual group row labels/format metadata absent.
ordinary_group_condition_consumers.query: Free normalizer preserves selected condition object and rebuilds groups as unique nonempty selected {prop_id} entries. Search mapper/projection definitions and original current template values remain dynamic/unobserved.
ordinary_group_condition_consumers.boundary: These are generic compatible consumers. No retained body defines current concrete product group1/2/3 ordinary GROUPBY projection, master join/version policy or server measure formula.

code_name_boundary.generic_subtotal_key: createValueExtractor returns value?.code for $$code; selected current product-group datatype is not retained. This is a generic subtotal/summary grouping helper, not current ordinary server GROUPBY proof.
code_name_boundary.generic_title: $$code_cd title uses value and optional association nm_prop_id to append (name); other types use external value formatter with dynamic value_format. This does not establish original product-group row display format or code-name source.
code_name_boundary.selected_axis_label: Selector display_name -> condition.label names the axis. It does not prove any individual category row code/name.

own_model_assessment.verdict: Feasible for an explicitly independent local group-code implementation; equivalence remains partial.
own_model_assessment.read_only_snapshot: Own implementation files are recorded with hashes in precise-static-evidence.json; parent may subsequently change them.
own_model_assessment.supported_fields: ItemCore declares group1/2/3 as text, trims/validates declared fields, and normalize maps legacy group -> group1 then keeps group alias equal to group1. groupNName are optional record extras preserved by object spreading, not explicit defaultFields or validated name/master-code registry entries.
own_model_assessment.existing_display: Purchasing report already reads current own master item by line.item and displays groupNName??groupN. Empty string Name is retained by ?? and does not fall back to code.
own_model_assessment.proposed_policy_boundary: Own groupN string can serve as the independently defined category key, with groupNName/code display fallback. Define blank and same-name/different-code behavior locally; neither name-based merging nor original SID equality is proven.
own_model_assessment.temporal_boundary: Current own report looks up the item master at report generation. Applying this to historical purchase lines uses the current own master classification; original current-master versus document snapshot classification is unknown.
own_model_assessment.hierarchy_boundary: Do not map hierarchyGroups to group1/2/3: own fields and legacy PROD_LEVEL_GROUP are separate. No automatic ancestor/descendant expansion is proven.
own_model_assessment.remaining_own_limits: End-to-end Name-field persistence/validation and group-master registry semantics were not investigated; no app code or tests ran.
